rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_constrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_constrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=25, recon_eta=1.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=False, recon_dcstep_every=5, recon_dcstep_n_cg=3, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=0.3, val_n=214, train_n=0, rationale=iter-3 search-20260619-01 CONSTRAINED diff-recon. ONE KNOB: recon_dcstep_relax 1.0->0.3 (the constrained-specific hard-CG blend; eta held at iter-2's 1.0). TRAJECTORY: iter-1 eta=30 SSIM 0.3937/hr0; iter-2 eta 30->1 REGRESSED to SSIM 0.2366/hr0 -> eta is the WRONG lever (gentling the DPS gain did not help; the corruption is elsewhere). FAILURE MODE (numbers): both prior iters ran recon_dcstep_relax=1.0 = FULL hard projection. In dc_step_cg() the return is relax*x_cg + (1-relax)*x0_mu; relax=1.0 discards the diffusion x0 estimate ENTIRELY and substitutes n_cg=3 Gauss-Newton least-squares fit to the NOISY 2304-view LD sinogram, which is then re-noised back to t_next every 5 reverse steps (warmup 5). That least-squares fit overfits measurement noise and overwrites the prior's structure -> hard-CG DC re-noises a corrupted x0, exactly the constrained variant's failure. The SOLVER DEFAULT is relax=0.5; relax=1.0 was an untested aggressive choice carried from iter-1. ONE KNOB: relax 1.0->0.3 blends 30% CG-projected + 70% diffusion x0, a GENTLE pull to data consistency that preserves prior structure instead of overwriting it. HYPOTHESIS: softening the hard-DC blend lifts SSIM back toward / above the ~0.81 LD-FBP floor (hr>0); predicted iter-3 SSIM 0.4-0.7 range (recovery from 0.2366). FALSIFIER: if SSIM stays well below FBP (~0.3 vs 0.81) even at relax=0.3, the Mayo v4 DDPM prior is STRUCTURALLY MISMATCHED to rebinned Mayo under the 25-step low-T DPS/DC budget (mirrors the breast-DDPM hr=0 verdict: globally faithful but not conditionally faithful) -> NEGATIVE RESULT, STOP diffusion on Mayo. BUDGET: relax is a blend scalar inside dc_step_cg -> ZERO compute change (same n_cg=3, n_steps=25, DC cadence every5). iter-2 ran ALL 214 L277 slices in 1033.8 s = 4.83 s/slice = 17.2 min < 20-min wall (1800s in-solver backstop never hit); iter-1 1018.96 s. iter-3 lands ~17 min, inside budget. val=ALL 214 L277, 321px detector-geometry FOV default.
